$comment: One app per kind of page Logix Engine shows (the page manifest's kind). Each is the same logix-viewer program with its own name, icon and identity, so each has its own Dock icon. Adding a kind: an entry here and its icon (icons/<icon>.svg, then icons/make-icons.py). viewer is the generic app, for kinds without their own yet. slot: how many steps in from the screen's corner the app's first window opens (logix-viewer --slot), so two apps' first windows don't hide each other.
